[b][color=#d5a6bd]installation:[/color][/b] drop the files from *.zip archive into your 'Stardew Valley\Mods' folder. keep in mind, that you need main [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url] mod files to use this!
[b][color=#c27ba0]how to get:[/color][/b] you need to buy a special catalogue from [b][u]Robin's shop[/u][/b]! after putting it on the wall (it works like a painting), you need to [b][u]right click[/u][/b] on it to open up the menu! ...or you can [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]cheat[/url] if you want lol
[b][color=#a64d79]bonus:[/color][/b] i also included a .pdn file with a bunch of separate layers so you can mix and match different parts, edit colors or draw on top of it. do as you wish! you need [b]paint.net[/b] to use it.

[right][b][color=#d5a6bd]p.s.: if you'll notice that something is wrong with the mod - please, let me know[/color][/b][/right]
